title: Surface chunk generator (terrain, nodes, landing pads)
description: Derive a planet surface chunk deterministically from (seed, planetId, chunkX, chunkZ): heightmap, biome, resource node placement, and landing pad placement. Any client can reconstruct any chunk identically without server data.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/shared/galaxy/surface.ts` exports `generateSurfaceChunk(seed: string, planet: Planet, chunkX: number, chunkZ: number): SurfaceChunk`

SurfaceChunk = { chunkX, chunkZ, heightmap: number[] (64x64, meters, Uint16-equivalent numbers), biome: 'plains'|'rock'|'canyon'|'frozen'|'wetland', resourceNodes: {nodeId: string, type: string, x: number, z: number, baseQuantity: number}[], landingPads: {id: string, x: number, z: number}[] }
nodeId = hex hash of (seed, planetId, chunkX, chunkZ, nodeIndex) — stable identity used by resource_node_state table
Heightmap is continuous across chunk borders (shared boundary noise sampling) — unit test compares neighboring chunk edge columns/rows for small deltas
1-4 resource nodes per chunk, types restricted to planet.resourceTypes; 0-1 landing pads (first chunk 0,0 of a landable planet always has exactly 1 pad)
Golden snapshot test: chunk (0,0) of the dev-seed landable planet deep-equals committed fixture (heightmap sampled at 16 points + all nodes + pads)
Determinism: two independent calls identical; 100 random chunks across 3 planets stable in a loop test

steps.details: Value noise: 2D lattice of pseudo-random values derived from hash2(chunkSeed, ix, iz), smoothstep interpolation. fBm: 4-5 octaves. Height = fBm(x*freq, z*freq) scaled by planet radius/terrain scale; biomes by height+moisture second noise channel.

Nodes: seeded count 1-4, positions from seeded rejection sampling (avoid biome 'wetland' for solid resources, avoid within 20m of pads), baseQuantity 50-200. Pads: 0-1 per chunk by seeded probability 0.25, snap to nearest flat area (gradient check); chunk (0,0) forced to 1 pad on landable planets.

Noise lattice coordinates are in *world* space (not chunk-local) so adjacent chunks share boundary samples. Test: generate chunks (0,0) and (1,0); max |delta| between shared column < noise epsilon (e.g. 0.5m at default scale).
Commit chunk fixture; add the 100-random-chunk stability loop (hash of each chunk JSON stable across two runs in same process and across a fresh Rng). Run `npm run test` + `npm run typecheck`.

technicalNotes: World-space lattice coords: lattice index = floor(worldX / latticeSize) so chunk borders align exactly.
Keep heightmap as plain number[] for JSON-serializable fixtures; the renderer converts to Float32Array.
